correctness.rationale: Every rank-one square-zero X has q−1 factorizations uv^T with v^Tu=0. The rank of the three constraints v(u), v(Ju), v(J²u) equals 1,2,3 according to the first two kernels; subtracting zero covectors gives the moment census. The natural kernel/cokernel pairing has rank equal to the number of size-one Jordan blocks c=2b−d, giving exact rank-zero and rank-one commutator strata. The identities C u=−tu, C Ju=tJu−su, C²=t(Ju v^T+u v^T J)−sX force all remaining Jordan types over every characteristic. An independently constructed direct enumerator tested 40 finite configurations with 34,015 distinct X; it is corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: The exact commutator similarity distribution is a natural invariant of the ordered pair consisting of one fixed nilpotent similarity class and the minimal nonzero nilpotent orbit. Complete moment fibers reveal that two nilpotent classes with different longer Jordan blocks may be indistinguishable by this census whenever the first two nullities match (e.g. partitions (5,3) and (4,4)). Exact arithmetic formulas in all field characteristics separate nilpotency-index-three and rank-two-square-zero strata and exhibit a characteristic-two nonsemisimple exception. This general structural classification is not an arbitrary finite slice or textbook substitution.
